name: opencode-gui
description: Cross-IDE GUI for opencode — chat, image/file attachments, search, and commands on top of the opencode server.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/webview && npm run build --workspace packages/extension
scripts.watch: npm run watch --workspace packages/webview & npm run watch --workspace packages/extension
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace packages/extension
